opening.argument: The title identifies a Sonic the Hedgehog real-time fandub, and the description says voice actors dub Sonic 06 dialogue in one take without rehearsal. Credits for the game footage and the original format reinforce that this is an attributed fan-made entertainment production. The Patreon line asks for financial support from interested viewers, but it does not present an investment return, require payment to watch, request credentials, or claim a transaction outcome. Nothing in the cited material establishes a deceptive claim or a loss; the financial request remains incidental to the described production.
